title: The Scarred Soldier
text:
*The man by the fire watches you approach with the calm assessment of someone who has killed before and keeps his sword close for a reason. Up close, you see old scars on his knuckles and a haunted look in his grey eyes.*

Edric: "You're not from here. Good. The locals have learned not to ask questions. Sit, if you like. I could use the company of someone who hasn't been broken yet."

*He introduces himself as Edric — once a sergeant in the Duke's own guard, now... something else. His discharge was sudden and unexplained.*

Edric: "I served the Duke for twelve years. Then one day, the new steward — Goran, weasel-faced bastard — told me my services were no longer required. Half the veteran guard got the same speech. Replaced by Harren's mercenaries."

*He takes a long drink.*

Edric: "Something rotten is growing in this city, friend. I can smell it. If you're here to dig, I might be willing to help — for the right reasons."

choices.text: "I'm investigating the disappearances. I could use a sword at my back."
"Tell me more about this steward, Goran."
"I work alone. But the information is useful."
Challenge Edric to an arm-wrestling match to earn his respect
